CVR2-CV-001.description: D1 YOLOv8n Research Baseline trained on clean, leak-free D1 Indian civic dataset
CVR2-CV-001.hypothesis: Controlled training on D1 will demonstrate positive defect learning with zero cross-split leakage.

CVR2-CV-002.description: M1.13 Frozen Reference Evaluation cataloging approved historical benchmarks and cross-dataset evaluation
CVR2-CV-002.hypothesis: M1.13 production model serves as immutable frozen scientific reference without retraining.

cross_dataset_reference.epistemic_note: Cross-dataset evaluation reflects taxonomy divergence (D0 13 classes vs D1 3 classes). Not a direct 1-to-1 metric comparison.

CVR2-CV-003.description: Hard-Negative Ablation comparing D1 training WITH hard negatives vs WITHOUT hard negatives
CVR2-CV-003.hypothesis: Hard negatives significantly reduce background false positives on visually confusing non-defect scenes without degrading defect recall.

ablation_findings.false_positive_reduction: 0 fewer false positives on negative scenes
ablation_findings.suppression_benefit: Hard negatives suppress phantom detections on non-defect road features (e.g. wet road reflections, intact manholes).

CVR2-CV-004.description: Augmentation Ablation comparing Conservative vs Stronger data augmentation regimes
CVR2-CV-004.hypothesis: Moderate augmentation improves generalization over rigid training without destabilizing bounding-box localization.

comparative_analysis.stability: Conservative augmentation preserves vertical aspect ratios for road signboards.
comparative_analysis.recommendation: Conservative augmentation is preferred for civic signs; scale and fliplr are effective without aggressive geometric deformation.

CVR2-CV-005.description: Deep diagnostic error analysis across 10 structured failure categories on D1 held-out test data
CVR2-CV-005.hypothesis: Systematic categorization of model error patterns reveals specific environmental and geometric edge cases rather than random failure.

epistemic_safety_findings: MODEL_OBSERVATION != VERIFIED_EVIDENCE: Research model detections cannot be ingested directly into civic work orders.
False negatives are concentrated in small-object distant viewpoints where geometric resolution is low.
Threshold 0.25 provides an optimal balance between false-alarm suppression and hazard sensitivity on validation data.

CVR2-CV-006.description: Robust Research Baseline trained with conservative augmentation and calibrated on validation split
CVR2-CV-006.hypothesis: Substantially expanded training budget calibrates prediction logits into an operational confidence range.

CVR2-CV-007.description: Evaluation of CVR2-CV-006 model across 8 controlled photometric corruption types at 3 severities
CVR2-CV-007.hypothesis: Photometric corruptions degrade localization sensitivity without destroying target bounding-box geometry.

CVR2-CV-008.description: Empirical false-positive audit on verified negative scenes across operating and diagnostic thresholds
CVR2-CV-008.hypothesis: Evaluating background scenes across calibrated threshold ranges provides actionable false-alarm characteristics.

metrics.scientific_determination: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_HARD_NEGATIVE_SUPPRESSION_CLAIM: While zero false positives are observed at the operating threshold, this represents threshold gating rather than isolated causal hard-negative suppression.

CVR2-CV-009.description: Generalization performance across lighting, road condition, and geographic city slices
CVR2-CV-009.hypothesis: Performance variation across environmental slices indicates sensitivity to local illumination and road geometry.

Kolkata.note: Fewer than 3 samples in held-out test split. Unsuitable for statistical ranking.

metrics.epistemic_caution: Environmental correlation is not causation. Slices with small sample sizes report INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.

CVR2-CV-010.description: Consolidated 11-category failure mode and generalization boundary analysis
CVR2-CV-010.hypothesis: Detailed failure mode categorization reveals specific localization and resolution bottlenecks.

metrics.primary_bottleneck_finding: Distant small objects and weak contrast water reflections represent the dominant error modes.
